_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your server details. config.local.json is git-ignored so your API key never gets committed. Every field can also be supplied via environment variables (UNRAID_HOST, UNRAID_PORT, UNRAID_HTTPS, UNRAID_API_KEY, UNRAID_VERIFY_SSL, UNRAID_TIMEOUT), which override the file. Generate the API key in the Unraid webGUI: Settings -> Management Access -> API Keys (grant it the ADMIN role for full control), or via SSH/Terminal: `unraid-api apikey add --name claude-mcp --roles admin`.
